examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A posting with four description sections beside the sticky rail (area, title, four facets and the apply link), then the application form with text, email, phone, URL and file fields. Submit with a required field empty or a malformed value to see the field messages; a valid submit fires `submit` and this example opens the confirmation dialog.

examples.name: States
examples.summary: The same band with `failed` set, so the failure alert shows under the submit button, and a button that sets `submitted` to open the confirmation dialog with its way back to the open positions.
